title: The Gentle voice of the nurse
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：gentle　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gentle 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the operator wrote of ① a gentle voice of the nurse in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② gentler than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the gentle ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the gentlest voice of the nurse anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the log for June 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too gentle to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the gentle ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a gentle rain on the roof, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as gentle as the rain on the roof they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was gentle or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something gentle, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite gentle; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the gentle ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another gentle voice of the nurse in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ gentler than anybody had expected. ⑩ The gentlest rain on the roof in the whole station, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the gentle ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 温和（前置定语 a gentle voice of the nurse：1991 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件温和的声音）
B. adj. 温和／轻柔（比较级 gentler than：文中两处，一处比护士温和的声音，一处比预想）
C. adj. 温和／轻柔（最高级 the gentlest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 温和（表语 too gentle to do：母亲觉得它太温和，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 轻柔（前置定语 a gentle rain on the roof：叔叔把整件事称作一桩轻柔的细雨）
F. adj. 轻柔（同级比较 as gentle as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩落在屋顶的细雨相比）
G. adj. 轻柔（后置定语 something gentle：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 轻柔（受程度副词修饰 quite gentle：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: a gentle voice of the nurse
the gentlest voice of the nurse anybody
a gentle rain on the roof
The gentlest rain on the roof in

answers.why: gentle 意为“温和”，1991 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件温和的声音”，此处作前置定语 a gentle voice of the nurse。
gentle 意为“温和”，此处用比较级 gentler than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
gentle 意为“温和”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说它是机房里最温和的一件，故用最高级 the gentlest voice of the nurse。
gentle 意为“温和”，母亲认为这件东西“太温和了，谁也用不上”，too gentle to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩轻柔的细雨”，此处作前置定语 a gentle rain on the roof。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩落在屋顶的细雨一样轻柔”，同级比较用 as gentle as。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“轻柔的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something gentle。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当轻柔”，quite 修饰原级 gentle。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，2001 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要轻柔”，故用比较级 gentler than。
gentle 意为“轻柔”，母亲 2003 年说的是“整个机房里最轻柔的那一桩”，故用最高级 the gentlest rain on the roof。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件温和的声音。（a gentle voice of the nurse）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更温和。（gentler than …）
母亲觉得它太温和，谁也用不上。（too gentle to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩轻柔的细雨。（a gentle rain on the roof）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩落在屋顶的细雨一样轻柔。（as gentle as …）
到了 1998 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件轻柔的东西。（something gentle）
answers: In 1991 the operator wrote of a gentle voice of the nurse in the log.
Everybody said it was gentler than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too gentle to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a gentle rain on the roof.
He said nobody would call it as gentle as the rain on the roof they had once had.
By 1998 the log asked for nothing but something gentle.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 gentle 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the operator wrote of a gentle voice of the nurse in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the gentlest voice of the nurse in the station, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too gentle to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a gentle rain on the roof, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite gentle, and everybody laughed.
The gentle ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
